theme: one icebreaker fleet threading cargo convoys through pack ice
title: Pack-Ice Convoy Leases: Riding the Refreeze Window
strategies: singleton baseline: escort every ship alone in its own convoy, round-robin across breakers in ship-index order (reproduces the checker's baseline)

destination-sorted capacity batching: sort ships by destination and pack consecutive groups of size c into escorted convoys, ignoring ship speed (mixes fast and slow ships, throttling every convoy to its slowest member and paying full breaker-return overhead per batch)

speed-bucketed escort-plus-lease: group ships into homogeneous-speed buckets, escort only up to c per bucket (the farthest-reaching member plus the highest weight*destination members) and let the rest of that bucket lease the escort's clear wake for free within the refreeze window

cross-speed lease timing: exploit the exact departure-offset window implied by the refreeze constant to also lease ships whose speed differs from the pilot convoy's, stretching one breaker pass across an even larger share of the fleet
